title: Northwind customer records by country
purpose: Independent read-only server aggregate: distinct Northwind customer records grouped by exact Country labels; each customer key is unique within this source. Declared measure: customer records, not shared people. Null Country records are excluded. The 2026-10-21 local pinned fixture had two such records; live data can change. Country aliases are not normalized: UK and United Kingdom remain distinct. The complete result is bounded to 100 country groups.
